mapper.update: UPDATE course_table SET selected_num = selected_num + 1, version = version + 1 WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND selected_num < max_num
UPDATE course_table SET selected_num = selected_num - 1 WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND selected_num > 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course_table (course_name, course_credit, max_num, selected_num, course_status, teacher_id, course_time, course_room) VALUES (#{courseName}, #{courseCredit}, #{maxNum}, 0, #{courseStatus}, #{teacherId}, #{courseTime}, #{courseRoom})
mapper.select: SELECT c.* FROM course_table c LEFT JOIN student_course_table sc ON c.course_id = sc.course_id WHERE sc.student_id = #{studentId}
SELECT * FROM course_table WHERE course_time = #{courseTime} AND course_room = #{courseRoom} AND course_status = 1
